added_pixel_inputs.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of finite values independently for each metric

Fig02d_cells.organization: One combined collection; condition and sample identifiers
Fig02d_cells.identity_or_exclusion_recipe: Use source integer labels directly, or set pixels to zero where the indexed exclusion mask is nonzero.
Fig02d_cells.object_selection: Exact retained source row and ID from the archived observation input; no date-specific statistical strata added.

Fig01b-d_eight_setting_screen.grouping: Low: 2 settings; Medium: 4 settings; High: 2 settings; descriptive pooling preserves all acquisitions

data_folder_roles.raw_for_GSLab: Channel TIFF inputs and original XML in matching MetaData folders

raw_acquisition_matching.selection: Only acquisition IDs linked to already selected Results exports; complete available channel triplets retained.
raw_acquisition_matching.series_xml: Shared by selected frames; original bytes and timestamps unchanged.
